archetypes.name: dyn-fd-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Check the raw-stderr descriptor and trap lifecycle across every child exit path.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 8 child stderr capture, file descriptor ownership, signal traps, and cleanup ordering. Verify raw bytes cannot survive or enter a merge envelope when sanitization or persistence fails. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
